svg.title: RL graph–rule co-optimization
svg.desc: A fixed-registry scheduling environment supplies fourteen features and an eight-action mask. A Double-DQN policy chooses one graph or rule operation. The environment updates graph and rule quality and returns reward. A separate training lane shows replay and target updates.
svg.text: Update G, R → quality gains − costs − new-violation penalty
Next observation and mask are recomputed from the updated environment.
Replay: (ot, at, rt, ot+1, done, mt+1)
Reward rt uses graph and rule quality gains.
